newsitem.title: FINLAND: KEMIRA UNIT BUYS NORWAY COIL COATING FIRM.
newsitem.headline: KEMIRA UNIT BUYS NORWAY COIL COATING FIRM.

text.p: Finnish chemicals group Kemira Oy's paint unit Tikkurila Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had acquired the coil coating business of Scanox A/S, part of the Norwegian Jotun group.
"Tikkurila Coatings Oy has bought the coil coating operations from Scanox A/S, which is part of the Norwegian Jotun group," Tikkurila said. It did not give any financial details of the deal.
Through the transaction Tikkurila will not get any new personnel or fixed assets, it said.
Tikkurila Coatings manufactures industrial paints in Finland, United Kingdom, Holland and Belgium.
